questions.subject: Civil Engineering
questions.questionMarkup:
Consider the following statements:
1. Crop period is significantly more than base period.
2. If water consumed by a crop is more in a given base period, then its duty will also be more.
3. The area where irrigation is not at all required is known as arid region.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
questions.questionText: Consider the following statements: 1. Crop period is significantly more than base period. 2. If water consumed by a crop is more in a given base period, then its duty will also be more. 3. The area where irrigation is not at all required is known as arid region. Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
questions.explanationHtml:
(d)
• Crop period is slightly more than base period.
• If water consumed by a crop is more in a given base period, then its duty will be less.
• The area where irrigation is a must is known as arid region.

questions.questionMarkup:
Which of the following statements are correct for estimation of evaporation using analytical methods?
1. Water budget method is complex and most reliable.
2. Energy budget method is an application of law of conservation of mass.
3. Mass transfer method is based on theories of turbulence mass transfer in the boundary layer.
questions.questionText: Which of the following statements are correct for estimation of evaporation using analytical methods? 1. Water budget method is complex and most reliable. 2. Energy budget method is an application of law of conservation of mass. 3. Mass transfer method is based on theories of turbulence mass transfer in the boundary layer.
questions.explanationHtml:
(c)
• Water budget method is simple and least reliable.
• Energy budget method is an application of law of conservation of energy.

questions.subject: Civil Engineering
questions.questionMarkup:
Consider the following statement about irrigation:
1. It is natural application of water to land.
2. It is artificial application of water to land.
3. It is continuous application of water to crops throughout the crop period.
4. It is the intermittent application of water to drops throughout the base period of crop.
Which of the above statements are INCORRECT ?
questions.questionText: Consider the following statement about irrigation: 1. It is natural application of water to land. 2. It is artificial application of water to land. 3. It is continuous application of water to crops throughout the crop period. 4. It is the intermittent application of water to drops throughout the base period of crop. Which of the above statements are INCORRECT ?
questions.explanationHtml:
(a)
Irrigation is artificial application of water to land at intermittent intervals throughout the crop period.

questions.explanationHtml:
(c)
• Spillways for major and medium irrigation projects with storages more than 60 Mm3 is designed with PMF and PMP.
• Permanent barrages and minor dams with capacity less than 60 Mm3 is designed with SPF and SPS.

questions.subject: Civil Engineering
questions.questionMarkup:
Consider the following statement:
1. Raingauge must be kept at a distance more than twice the height of obstruction.
2. Raingauge must be surrounded by open fenced square area of atleast 20.25 m2.
3. To know the rainfall intensity in the area, at most 90% of raingauges can be of non-recording type.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are true?
questions.questionText: Consider the following statement: 1. Raingauge must be kept at a distance more than twice the height of obstruction. 2. Raingauge must be surrounded by open fenced square area of atleast 20.25 m 2 . 3. To know the rainfall intensity in the area, at most 90% of raingauges can be of non-recording type. Which of the above statement(s) is/are true?
questions.explanationHtml:
(a)
• Raingauge must be kept at a distance more than twice the height of obstruction.
• To know the rainfall intensity in the area, atleast 10% of raingauges must be of recording type
i.e. at most 90% of raingauges can be of non-recording type.
